senses.gloss:
mf. (-लः-ला)
Meeting, union, assemblage; in the modern dialects, applied to a large concourse of people collected at stated periods for religious or commercial purposes, as at Haridvār, &c.
f. (-ला)
1 Ink.
2 Antimony or any collyrium.
E.
मिल to mix, to meet, aff. घञ्; also with ल्युट्, aff. मेलन.

m. (-कः)
Meeting, union, assemblage.
E.
मेल the same, कन् added.

n. (-नं)
1 Meeting, assembling.
2 Encounter.
3 Associating with.
4 Mixing with.
5 Adding to.
E.
मिल to mix, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Mixing, adding, or causing to be mixed with, or added to.
E.
मिल to mix, causal v., शतृ aff.

mf. (-न्दः-न्दा)
An inkstand.
E.
मेला ink, आनन्द delighting.

f. (-न्धुः)
An inkstand.
E.
मेला ink, अन्धु a well.

m. (-म्बुः)
An inkstand.
E.
मेला ink, अम्बु water.
